detail: Instagram restriction/challenge (ChallengeRequired): Manual verification required via Instagram native challenge flow. This checkpoint is not handled by challenge_code_handler or change_password_handler; complete it in the official Instagram app or web flow on a trusted device. Retry with the same saved client settings, device identifiers, and proxy/IP.
remediation: Option A: Run `python3 scripts/vynox_update_bio_and_dispatch.py --bio-only` on trusted local machine.
Option B: Export fresh session with `python3 scripts/insta_local_post.py --export-session` and update GitHub Secret INSTA_SESSION_JSON.
Option C: Configure INSTA_GRAPH_ACCESS_TOKEN and INSTA_IG_USER_ID for zero-session Meta Graph API.
